critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~2240 lines — consider router splits (auth, parties, accounts, reports, rokad, backup) for maintainability.

Preview deployment serves cookies with SameSite=None;Secure (needed for cross-site preview host); the spec text said SameSite=Lax. Both are acceptable here — SameSite=None;Secure+httpOnly is required for a cross-origin preview URL, and CSRF guard (header+origin check) is what actually prevents cross-site writes. If the goal is Lax on same-site deployments, backend code already appears to adapt; this is informational, not a bug.

Non-/api paths /docs, /redoc, /openapi.json fall through to the frontend React SPA (returns index.html with 200). The actual backend equivalents under /api are correctly 404, so no OpenAPI schema leaks. Still fine with current ingress rule.
